review: Tự soạn theo Result/extension/Repository. https://kotlinlang.org/docs/sealed-classes.html ; https://kotlinlang.org/docs/object-declarations.html . data object yêu cầu compiler hỗ trợ (ổn định từ Kotlin1.9).
